svg.title: Tracking events through a funnel
svg.desc: Tracking events and the engine events that send them, across a funnel. On every page: page_viewed on sdk.ready; product_added_to_cart, product_removed_from_cart and cart_updated on cart.calculated; promotion_viewed on promotion.viewed and promotion_selected on promotion.clicked. Landing: product_viewed for one package on the page, product_list_viewed for several, on sdk.ready. Checkout: checkout_started on checkout.started, checkout_contact_info_submitted on user.created, checkout_shipping_address_submitted on address.entered, checkout_shipping_method_submitted on shipping.selected, checkout_payment_info_submitted on checkout.submitted, checkout_completed on order.paid. Upsell: upsell_viewed on upsell.viewed, upsell_skipped on upsell.skipped, upsell_completed on order.loaded for the upsell accepted on the page before. Receipt: upsell_completed on order.loaded, and checkout_completed on order.loaded only when the checkout page was left before it was sent.
